about_us_intro: Welcome to Mero Audio Player! This app is developed by Sleman Dayoub to provide a smooth and enjoyable music experience for all users.
about_us_mission: Our mission is to provide an advanced offline music player that supports all formats, offers extensive customization options, and ensures a comfortable user experience.
about_us_features_point1: - Play local audio files in all formats.
about_us_features_point2: - Customizable interface: change colors and backgrounds.
about_us_features_point3: - Audio equalizer and playback speed control.
about_us_features_point4: - Support for playlists, albums, and artists.
about_us_features_point5: - Cut and set ringtones directly from the app.
about_us_features_point6: - Share audio files with other apps.
about_us_contact: You can follow our official channels or contact us via email:
privacy_policy_header: Privacy Policy for Mero Audio Player
privacy_policy_intro: At Mero Audio Player, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your data while using the app. This is a personal app owned by Sleman Dayoub.
section1_point1: - The app does not collect or share any personal data with third parties.
section1_point2: - Audio files, playlists, and ringtones are stored only on your device’s local storage.
section2_point1: - Locally stored data is used only to enhance your experience within the app.
section2_point2: - None of this data is transmitted or shared over the internet.
section3_point1: - The app requests permissions to access local audio files solely for playback.
section3_point2: - No other data is accessed without your explicit consent.
section4_point1: - All data remains on your device to minimize any risk of exposure.
section4_point2: - We recommend securing your device with strong passwords to protect your privacy.
section5_point1: - Users can delete or modify their local data at any time.
section5_point2: - Users can revoke app permissions from their device settings.
section6_point1: For any questions regarding this privacy policy, please contact us at:
section7_point1: - This policy may be updated from time to time to comply with new regulations and improve privacy practices.
section7_point2: - Users will be notified of any significant changes to the policy.
